name: Pack Fighting
description: Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature) When you make a melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against a creature, you gain a +1 bonus to the damage roll if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition. If at least one ally within 5 feet of the creature also has this feat and doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition, this bonus increases to +2.
